annotations.title: Create a shared expense group link

description: Creates a Halves group and returns a link anyone can open (no sign-up) to add and fix expenses and see who owes whom. Optionally pre-loads expenses. Anyone who has the link can edit the group, so share it only with the people in it. Groups are kept for about 400 days after the last change.

expenses.description: Optional starting expenses (up to 50), same shape as the settle tool.
